data.one_liner: OpenID Connect RP plugin for Flutter supporting all platforms.
data.what_it_does: Implements an OpenID Connect Relying Party plugin for Flutter that works across Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, Web, and macOS. It handles authorization flows, token refreshing, discovery, session management, and client registration.
use_when: You need OpenID Connect or OAuth authentication in a cross-platform Flutter app
You require support for platforms like Windows, Linux, and macOS alongside mobile and web
avoid_when: You only need a simple proprietary backend client like Firebase Authentication without OIDC standards
strengths: Supports all Flutter platforms including desktop
OpenID Connect Certified Relying Party with conformance testing
High customizability and automatic token refresh rotation
weaknesses: Session management features have platform constraints (web only for check_session_iframe)
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific redirect setup and reading the documentation wiki for getting started steps.
